name: gamebeast
description: Analyze players, run A/B experiments, and tune live games with Gamebeast skills and the Gamebeast MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Understand and operate your live game with Gamebeast: query insights, funnels, retention, and heatmaps; build dashboards and player cohorts; design, ramp, and read out A/B experiments; tune remote configurations and in-game economies; plan LiveOps events; read community sentiment; and instrument your Roblox, Unity, Unreal, Godot, or web game end to end through the Gamebeast MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Give me a weekly review of how my game is doing
Why did day-1 retention drop last week?
Instrument this game with Gamebeast events and a remote configuration
